proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord does not include a magic_item kind. types.ts has no MagicItemRecord type and the tracer has no handler for kind='magic_item'. This blocks all magic items from being encoded.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While this bowl is filled with water and you are within 5 feet of it, you can take a Magic action to summon a Water Elemental.

proposed_widenings.name: dawn_reset (RestResetCadence)
proposed_widenings.justification: The bowl resets at the next dawn — not a short or long rest. No existing RestResetCadence variant covers calendar-time resets.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The bowl can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

proposed_widenings.name: create_companion
proposed_widenings.justification: The core effect is summoning a named creature type (Water Elemental) that obeys commands and acts on the user's initiative. The v4 taxonomy lists create_companion as an effect atom but it is absent from types.ts Effect union and from ClassFeatureEffect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to summon a Water Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the bowl as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count.

proposed_widenings.name: proximity_and_fill_activation_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: Activation requires (a) the bowl to be filled with water and (b) the user to be within 5 feet of it. No existing activation-condition or gate shape covers item-state + range prerequisites.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While this bowl is filled with water and you are within 5 feet of it, you can take a Magic action...

notes: Primary blocker is structural: magic_item is not a valid UnitRecord kind in types.ts, and the tracer has no handler for it. Secondary blockers (create_companion effect atom, dawn reset cadence, proximity+fill condition) would require further widening even after the record kind is added. No Dhall/JSON content file authored per protocol.
